experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives for employee engagement, branding, recruitment, and onboarding.

Worked with HR and management stakeholders to deliver assets with low revision cycles.
Managed print-ready files including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.
Applied AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly) for ideation and creative exploration.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Designed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.

Used Photoshop and Illustrator to build product visuals and marketing assets.
Conducted usability testing and applied findings to improve user flows and interface usability.
Collaborated with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.
